# Carlton Waiti

> Professional portfolio of Carlton Waiti, a Nairobi-based financial analyst working across corporate finance, financial analysis, economics, data and technology.

## Professional Profile

Carlton Waiti is a financial analyst based in Nairobi, Kenya.

He holds a Bachelor of Economics from Kenyatta University (2022–2026).

His professional interests and capabilities span financial analysis, corporate finance, business performance analysis, financial modelling, valuation, economics, data analysis and financial technology.
